svg.title: SvelteKit and Hono on Lambda Web Functions
svg.desc: A user calls the SvelteKit frontend's public Lambda Web Function endpoint; its server calls the Hono backend's IamAuth endpoint with SigV4, and the backend reads and atomically increments the click count in a DynamoDB table.
